value: The managed hosting at libretranslate.com does NOT currently offer a free API tier. Per the official FAQ: 'While we would love to offer low volume keys free of charge, it's just not sustainable for us (we tried in the past).' Paid plans start at $29/mo (Pro, up to 80 translations/min) and $58/mo (Business, up to 200/min), both with a 7-day money-back guarantee. The underlying software is open-source (Argos Translate) and free to self-host with no limits - that is the only genuinely free path to this API.
